about_the_game:
Create, explore, and share adventures in a unique puzzle-like multiverse.

This game is both an adventure builder and a puzzle-exploration quest. It combines gameplay with creation tools, letting players design their own interconnected worlds and share them with the community.

What’s in the game right now (Early Access):

  • Quest exploration: Travel through a multi-connected space where every passage leads to new rooms, challenges, and discoveries.

  • Room editor: Place and arrange rooms on a 2D slice of multidimensional space. Customize how rooms connect through passages.

  • Pickable items: Add objects that can be collected and interacted with during gameplay.

  • NPCs: Place simple characters, adjust their poses, and create dialogue trees.

  • Event triggers: Define conditions that react to player actions and change the world state (e.g. opening doors, unlocking puzzles, or changing NPC behavior).

  • Custom assets: Upload your own .glb models to create new items or decorations.

  • Cloud sharing: Publish your levels to the cloud, browse creations from other players, and download them directly in-game.

Planned features as the project grows:

  • More puzzle mechanics and interactive objects.

  • Expanded NPC behaviors, quests, and character progression.

  • Powerful customization tools for creating complete story-driven adventures.

  • Community hub for sharing, rating, and improving player-made content.

Your imagination is the main resource. Build connected spaces, design puzzles, create stories, and share them with others. If you enjoy creative freedom, puzzle-like exploration, and building games together with a community, this project is for you.

Join us in Early Access and help shape the future of the adventure builder.
